combo_label: Farms & Farming × Silly English Things × Alice in Wonderland

entries.clue: Long, energetic fussing that achieves precisely nothing
One whole woolly coat, lifted away in a single piece at clipping
Tight-packed block or roll of dried grass, dropped in the field by machine
Four in the afternoon, when broiling for dinner begins, says Humpty Dumpty
Sandwiches eaten in a stiff gale because the sun briefly came out
The local: warm beer, low beams and — unlike an inn — no beds upstairs
Gleeful snorting laugh coined in Jabberwocky, now a dictionary word
Spiked implement dragged across ploughed land to break the clods down
Thoroughly hoodwink, in a word that sounds sillier than the trick itself
Insect the size of a chicken that names the rocking-horse-fly for Alice
It described the sword that went snicker-snack through the Jabberwock
